entries.review: Read all changed count sites with caller error and final publication paths. Shared stdin byte-count helper checks native wc status before Bash-only whitespace normalization and decimal validation; no formatting pipeline can hide failure. Inventory (task evidence, contract evidence, declared output), head/tail elision and final/rebuilt bundle measurement all check helper results before admission/publication. Existing _ppi_io_error remains tool error2. Elision markers receive canonical unpadded digits; expected markers are not relaxed. Measurement now streams exactly the existing header/content printf bytes, retaining trailing newlines rather than losing them through command substitution. Diagnostic-only counts in the already-rejected exit1 branch remain outside admission. No new public option, encoding, elision ordering, consent behavior or output writer introduced.

Read all three preview measurements and existing final Set-Content Utf8 -NoNewline then Add-Content empty-value writer. The single byte-count helper adds the actual host newline and, on PowerShell before6, the UTF8 BOM emitted by that unchanged writer. All tier rebuilds use the helper. Existing output content/encoding/line endings remain unchanged; only budget admission uses actual serialized length. Actual Linux pwsh7 populated/empty controls verify count; Desktop BOM and Windows CRLF correspond to documented existing writer behavior and still require native execution, not claimed from Linux.

Read added fixtures with run_prepare, existing 052/062 independent marker/count oracles, temporary-root cleanup and publication assertions. A local wc executable delegates to the real binary then pads decimal output, emulating BSD formatting without changing count. Exit17 and malformed-success modes are explicit controls; environment injection is scoped to each invocation. Tests drive the public CLI with inventory-bearing and measurement-only inputs and require tool error2 plus absent output. Actual baseline file length independently determines cap-minus1 and exact-cap cases for populated and empty input; no expected count is read from the implementation. Existing 192 assertions remain; no skip added.

Read added actual CLI boundary loop within existing try/finally temporary root and process helper. Published file Length supplies independent cap oracle; populated/empty cases each require cap-minus1 exit1 with no output, and exact-cap success with identical actual length. Writer encoding/line ending differences are included automatically in the file-length oracle. No weaker digest matching, platform skip, new process transport or expected-count derivation from production code.

reuse_decision: Local checked-byte-count helper replaces repeated unchecked native count/filter expressions at one admission owner. PowerShell measurement helper matches its existing serializer. Neither adds configuration nor a new public abstraction.
